selectedWork.title: PMO Decision Brief Builder
selectedWork.summary: A public workflow surface for turning PMO prioritization context into a reviewer-ready decision brief.
selectedWork.problem: Busy teams need a clearer way to convert scattered operational context into reviewable decisions.
selectedWork.contribution: Built the public workflow surface and shaped the brief around prioritization, context, and action clarity.
selectedWork.whyItMatters: Shows product judgment, workflow design, and front-end implementation in one live artifact.

caseStudy.proof: Live route verified from the deployment source.
caseStudy.reviewFor: How the interface turns priority, context, and next action into a brief a reviewer can scan.

media.alt: Screenshot of the PMO Decision Brief Builder public fixture page showing a decision question, fixture notes, and a recommendation panel.
media.caption: Public fixture screenshot, captured from the live demo route.
media.safetyRationale: The visible page is a public demo with fixture-only PMO notes and no private records, credentials, email addresses, or customer data.

source.notes: Deployment remains reachable and is currently used as public product evidence.

selectedWork.title: BioScript Housing Decision
selectedWork.summary: A public BioScript-facing prototype route for making a constrained housing decision easier to review.
selectedWork.problem: A regulated support context needs review surfaces that reduce ambiguity without overstating automation.
selectedWork.contribution: Framed the demo around decision support, handoff clarity, and public-safe evidence rather than hidden internal data.
selectedWork.whyItMatters: Connects current BioScript-facing work to the portfolio while keeping private workflow details out of public copy.

caseStudy.proof: Live route verified from the deployment source.
caseStudy.reviewFor: How the demo separates criteria, tradeoffs, and handoff without exposing private workflow details.

source.notes: Public deployment endpoint verified during evidence pass.

selectedWork.title: Agent Permission Review Console
selectedWork.summary: A permission-review workflow that makes agent access decisions explicit, reviewable, and less fragile.
selectedWork.problem: Agent-heavy workflows create authorization risk when permissions are approved without a visible review trail.
selectedWork.contribution: Built a synthetic console that models least-privilege review, approval-state traceability, and scope checks.
selectedWork.whyItMatters: Signals AI governance instincts alongside implementation skill, which is stronger than a generic app demo.

caseStudy.proof: Repository verified from the Hardik-S public source.
caseStudy.reviewFor: How the workflow makes request scope, approval state, and least-privilege review visible.

source.notes: Public repository included as public-ready selected work after verification in this increment.

selectedWork.title: Invoice Dispute Packet Builder
selectedWork.summary: A decision-support repository for packaging dispute context, evidence, and next actions into a reviewable packet.
selectedWork.problem: Support work can lose time when dispute context, evidence, and next actions are not packaged consistently.
selectedWork.contribution: Modeled a packet-building flow that keeps supporting evidence and response structure auditable.
selectedWork.whyItMatters: Demonstrates practical automation that improves review quality without claiming unverified production impact.

caseStudy.proof: Repository verified from the Hardik-S public source.
caseStudy.reviewFor: How the packet structure keeps facts, evidence, and response steps aligned for review.

source.notes: Public repository validated for route checks and retained as a selected work artifact.
